description_en: Queries the details of a penetration test application
description_zh: 查询渗透测试申请详情
name: QueryPenetrationTestDetail

parameters.help_en:
The unique ID of the application record.

This field is of the Long type. Precision loss may occur when you serialize or deserialize the value. Make sure that the value does not exceed 9007199254740991
parameters.help_zh:
申请记录的唯一标识 ID。

该字段类型为 Long，在序列化/反序列化的过程中可能导致精度丢失，请注意数值不得大于 9007199254740991
parameters.name: id

Code.description_en:
The status code.

200: success
Other values (400, 500): failure

AssetType.description_en:
The asset type. Valid values:

EIP: public IP address of a VPC
SLB: load balancing
ECS: public IP address of an ECS instance in the classic network
AssetType.description_zh:
资产的类型。取值：

EIP：VPC公网IP
SLB：负载均衡
ECS：经典网络公网IP

Id.description_en:
The unique ID of the application record.

This field is of the Long type. Precision loss may occur when you serialize or deserialize the value. Make sure that the value does not exceed 9007199254740991
Id.description_zh:
申请记录的唯一标识 ID。

该字段类型为 Long，在序列化/反序列化的过程中可能导致精度丢失，请注意数值不得大于 9007199254740991

IsThirdpartyTest.description_en:
Indicates whether the test is performed by a third-party service provider.

true: Yes.
false: No
IsThirdpartyTest.description_zh:
是第三方测试服务商。

true：是

false：否

Status.description_en:
The task status. Valid values:

early_end: The user applies for early termination.
expired: The authorization has expired.
auditing: The application is being reviewed.
approved: The application is approved.
rejected: The application is rejected
Status.description_zh:
任务状态。

early_end：用户申请提前结束
expired： 授权到期
auditing：审核中
approved: 审核通过
rejected: 审核未通过

TestContent.description_en:
The test content.

The content must be within 500 characters. Carefully fill in the content to increase the chance of passing the review
TestContent.description_zh:
测试内容。

500字以内，认真填写，更容易通过审核

TestSourceIps.description_en:
The source IP addresses used for the test.

You can specify up to 50 IP addresses. Separate multiple IP addresses with line breaks or commas (,). Specify 0.0.0.0 to allow all IP addresses. CIDR blocks are not supported, such as 140.168.0.0/16
TestSourceIps.description_zh:
测试使用源IP。

最多支持50个IP,请使用换行或','分隔录入,0.0.0.0代表全部放行。不支持CIDR,如:140.168.0.0/16

TestSteps.description_en:
The test steps.

The content must be within 500 characters. Carefully fill in the content to increase the chance of passing the review
TestSteps.description_zh:
测试步骤。

500字以内，认真填写，更容易通过审核

ThirdpartyEmail.description_en: The email address of the third-party tester

ThirdpartyMobile.description_en: The mobile phone number of the third-party tester

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful.

true: The call is successful.                               
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功：

true：调用成功。                               
false：调用失败
